verdicts.rationale: Stage A traces cleaned IVS/WVS files (full_clean_ivs, ivs_selected_countries_*, wvs_clean_*_waves) to .do and .R files. README structure lists raw WVS_Trend_v2_0.dta and EVS ZA7503 files. Earlier waves 1–6 files also exist.

verdicts.claim_label: Comparative Manifesto Project (CMP) and manifesto texts / DeepL
verdicts.rationale: manifesto.csv/.dta and manifesto_parties.rds are referenced by many code files. verdicts.rationale: insult_scores_google.rds exists in both cleandata and authorcreated. measure_manifesto_style.R is plausibly the script that computes the insult score. The authorcreated MissingManifestos/manifesto_texts.csv fits the supplementary texts. Stage A links insult_scores_google.rds only to preflight.R, so the tracing is indirect.

verdicts.claim_label: GPT-4o classification of manifesto clauses as pledges
verdicts.rationale: Pledge scripts exist: load_pledge_data.R, process_pledge.R and prepare_pledge.R. The authorcreated Pledges/ClassifiedManifestos.csv and manifesto_parties_pledge.rds are listed. Stage A shows process_pledge.R and prepare_pledge.R referencing manifesto data.
